R535.note: length > buffer_len - offset is overflow-free and, with the retained offset check, admits exactly the in-range pairs the contract requires.

R536.note: Scheme allowlist blocks javascript:/data:, but parsed.href is interpolated without escapeAttribute and mailto: is an opaque path that keeps raw quotes and spaces (confirmed in Node: new URL('mailto:a" onmouseover="alert(1)').href is unchanged), so the attribute can still be broken out of; separately, scheme-less URLs such as example.com now silently render as # where the original rendered them.
